newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.01 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.01 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.518 to the dollar after Monday's fixing at 26.465, and at 17.541 to the mark from 17.520.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +4.01 percent after a deviation of +4.15 on Monday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown traded at +4.00 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
